I am an incoming postdoc in the [Bohórquez Lab](https://gutbrains.com/) at Duke University. I seek to understand how the gut senses dietary substrates and communicates that information with the brain, with the broader goal of understanding how diet shapes behavior.

I earned my PhD in 2026 through the University of Tokyo while completing my research training as a Fellow at Harvard University, where I examined how industrialized diets influence eating behavior through the microbiome-gut-brain axis.

Beyond research, I make [ceramics](ceramics.qmd).
